label: rem:motivic-galois-character-remark
title: The motivic Galois character and the obstruction classes
html:
The motivic-Galois layer on the obstruction \kappa_n \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m) acts via a single character of the cyclotomic Galois group: the motivic Galois character of the Frobenius–Hopf substrate. The obstruction \kappa_n (quantum characteristic classes) is the image of \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A under the HKR comparison to H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m).

Choice of level. The Čech-cocycle and Hochschild presentations of \kappa_n become realizations of \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A at the archimedean and Hochschild-deformation places. The Hochschild–Kummer duality corresponds to the duality between these two realizations.

Conditional on the motivic substrate, the character \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A is defined and is compatible with each local realization \rho_p.
